ONE PIECE CARD GAME Official Card Errata
Comprehensive Rules Ver. 1.24
Updated: 2025/09/05
©Eiichiro Oda/Shueisha, Toei Animation

OP01-016 Nami
Effective Date: 2023-03-10
Before:
[On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 Straw Hat Crew
type card and add it to your hand.
After:
[On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {Straw Hat Crew}
type card other than [Nami] and add it to your hand.
Note: Added "other than [Nami]" to match the Japanese card text.

Card No.: ST10-001
Card Name: Trafalgar Law
Incorrect: [Activate: Main] Place 1 of your opponent's Characters with 3000 power or less
at the bottom of the owner's deck.
Corrected: [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] DON!! -3: Place up to 1 of your opponent's
Characters with 3000 power or less at the bottom of the owner's deck. See Rule 7-1-2-1.
